-- The expired predecessor's unexpired lease must still fence its same-key successor.
            INSERT INTO outbox_messages (
                id,
                message_id,
                message_type,
                message_version,
                content_type,
                payload,
                metadata,
                ordering_key,
                claimable_at,
                expires_at,
                claim_token,
                locked_by
            )
            VALUES
                (
                    $1,
                    uuidv7(),
                    'postgres.expired-leased-predecessor',
                    1,
                    'application/test',
                    ''::bytea,
                    '{}'::jsonb,
                    'postgres-expired-lease-key',
                    now() + interval '1 hour',
                    now() - interval '1 minute',
                    uuidv7(),
                    'current-worker'
                ),
                (
                    $2,
                    uuidv7(),
                    'postgres.expired-leased-successor',
                    1,
                    'application/test',
                    ''::bytea,
                    '{}'::jsonb,
                    'postgres-expired-lease-key',
                    now(),
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL
                )
